cd /workspace/project/src/eywa && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='wire.py'; src=open(path).read()
old_start = src.index("    buffer = bytes(payload)\n")
old_end = src.index("    objects = {}\n")
new = '''    buffer = bytes(payload)
    total = len(buffer)
    unpack = _unpack
    # magic(5) + version(4) + argument_count(4) + argv_count(4) + argv_len(4)
    # + object_count(4) is the smallest possible well formed header.
    if total < 25:
        raise TransportError('truncated KTEST payload')
    if buffer[:5] != MAGIC:
        raise TransportError('missing KTEST magic')
    (version,) = unpack('>I', buffer, 5)
    if version != VERSION:
        raise TransportError('unsupported KTEST version')
    offset = 9
    (argument_count,) = unpack('>I', buffer, offset)
    offset += 4
    if argument_count > MAX_ARGUMENTS:
        raise TransportError('too many transport arguments')
    for _ in range(argument_count):
        if offset + 4 > total:
            raise TransportError('truncated argument length')
        (size,) = unpack('>I', buffer, offset)
        offset += 4
        if size > MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES:
            raise TransportError('transport argument is too large')
        if offset + size > total:
            raise TransportError('truncated argument blob')
        offset += size
    if offset + 12 > total:
        raise TransportError('truncated symbolic argv bookkeeping')
    # Symbolic argv bookkeeping is recorded but ignored.
    offset += 8
    (object_count,) = unpack('>I', buffer, offset)
    offset += 4
'''
src = src[:old_start] + new + src[old_end:]
